title: Electricity Theft Detection — Dual-Branch CNN-LSTM
description: AI-based smart-meter theft detector on the SGCC benchmark (18,193 consumers). Combines a CNN-LSTM temporal branch with 59 engineered statistical features, 12 synthetic theft-generation techniques, and threshold optimisation — reaching 91.2% accuracy and 96.9% AUC-ROC, deployed as a Streamlit risk-scoring app.
